title: Đề 1 – kiểu Cầu Giấy
desc: Khuôn kiểu THCS Cầu Giấy: ngữ âm, trắc nghiệm, chia động từ, điền từ vào đoạn văn, đọc hiểu, viết lại câu.

sections.title: I. Ngữ âm
sections.instruction: Câu 1–3: phát âm; câu 4–5: trọng âm.

items.prompt: Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác.
items.explain: bags: /z/. books, cups, cats: /s/.

items.prompt: Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác.
items.explain: cat: /æ/. cake, take, make: /eɪ/.

items.prompt: Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác.
items.explain: played: /d/. watched, washed, looked: /t/.

items.prompt: Chọn từ có trọng âm khác.
items.explain: behind nhấn âm 2; pencil (âm 1), rubber (âm 1), teacher (âm 1).

items.prompt: Chọn từ có trọng âm khác.
items.explain: computer nhấn âm 2; holiday (âm 1), family (âm 1), beautiful (âm 1).

sections.title: II. Chọn đáp án đúng
sections.instruction: Chọn A, B, C hoặc D để hoàn thành câu.

items.prompt: There ___ a lot of books on my desk.
items.explain: a lot of books là số nhiều: There are.

items.prompt: My mother ___ to work by car every day.
items.explain: "every day", My mother = she: goes.

items.prompt: We ___ to the cinema last Sunday.
items.explain: "last Sunday": quá khứ, go → went.

items.prompt: Mount Fansipan is the ___ mountain in Viet Nam.
items.explain: the + so sánh nhất: the highest.

items.prompt: I'm hungry. ___ we have lunch now?
items.explain: Rủ cùng làm gì: Shall we…?

items.prompt: My birthday is ___ 25th December.
items.explain: Ngày cụ thể dùng on.

items.prompt: She is very good ___ drawing.
items.explain: good at + V-ing.

items.prompt: ___ do you go to the dentist? – Twice a year.
items.explain: Trả lời "Twice a year" (tần suất): How often.

items.prompt: Would you like ___ some cake?
items.explain: would like + to V.

items.prompt: Lan is ___ girl in my class.
items.explain: So với cả lớp: the tallest.

sections.title: III. Chia động từ
sections.instruction: Gõ dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc.

items.prompt: Listen! The birds (sing) ___.
items.explain: "Listen!": hiện tại tiếp diễn, the birds số nhiều: are singing.

items.prompt: My brother (not like) ___ milk.
items.explain: Phủ định hiện tại đơn, ngôi 3 số ít: doesn't like.

items.prompt: Last summer we (visit) ___ Hue.
items.explain: "Last summer": visited.

items.prompt: I think it (rain) ___ tomorrow.
items.explain: Dự đoán về ngày mai: will rain.

items.prompt: She enjoys (play) ___ badminton.
items.explain: enjoy + V-ing: playing.

sections.title: IV. Điền từ vào đoạn văn
sections.instruction: Chọn từ đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: My neighbourhood
items.passage: I live in a small town near Ha Noi. My neighbourhood is quiet (21) ___ beautiful. There (22) ___ a big park near my house. Every morning, many old people (23) ___ exercise there. There is also a market (24) ___ my house and the post office. I often go there (25) ___ my mother at the weekend. The people here are very (26) ___. They always help each other. In the evening, children play games (27) ___ the street. Last month, a new library (28) ___ in my neighbourhood. I go there (29) ___ Saturdays to read books. I love my neighbourhood very (30) ___.

items.explain: Hai tính từ cùng ý tốt: quiet and beautiful.
a big park số ít: There is.
Every morning, many old people (số nhiều): do exercise.
between … and …: ở giữa hai nơi.
Đi cùng mẹ: with my mother.
Sau very cần tính từ: friendly.
Chơi ngoài đường: in the street.
"Last month": quá khứ đơn, opened.
Thứ trong tuần: on Saturdays.
Cụm cố định: very much.

sections.title: V. Đọc hiểu
sections.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn và chọn đáp án đúng.

items.title: Peter's day
items.passage: Peter is eleven years old. He lives with his parents and his little sister in London. On weekdays, Peter gets up at seven o'clock. He has breakfast and then walks to school with his friend Tom. School starts at half past eight and finishes at three. Peter's favourite subject is art because he loves drawing animals. After school, he plays the guitar or reads comics. At the weekend, his family often goes to the countryside to visit his grandparents, who have a big farm with cows and horses.

items.prompt: How does Peter go to school?
items.explain: "walks to school": đi bộ.

items.prompt: What time does school finish?
items.explain: "finishes at three".

items.prompt: Why does Peter like art?
items.explain: "because he loves drawing animals".

items.prompt: Which is NOT true?
options: Peter's grandparents live in a city.
items.explain: Ông bà sống ở nông thôn (countryside), có trang trại; ý C sai.

items.prompt: What can you find on his grandparents' farm?
items.explain: "a big farm with cows and horses".

sections.title: VI. Viết lại câu
sections.instruction: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa không đổi.

items.prompt: Minh is shorter than Nam.
items.explain: shorter ↔ taller.

items.prompt: What about going swimming?
items.explain: What about + V-ing = Let's + V.

items.prompt: My class has 35 students.
answers: are thirty-five students in my class
are thirty five students in my class
items.explain: … has … = There are … in …

items.prompt: He is a good footballer.
items.explain: a good footballer = plays football well.

items.prompt: Why don't we go to the park?
items.explain: Why don't we…? = Shall we…?
